name: markdown_converter
spec: Create a command-line tool that converts Markdown files to HTML using only the standard library. The tool takes a .md file as input and produces a .html file as output. It should handle common Markdown syntax elements and produce valid, well-structured HTML with a basic stylesheet for readability.
features: Accepts a markdown file path as a command-line argument
Outputs an HTML file with the same name but .html extension
Converts headings (h1 through h6 using # syntax) to HTML heading tags
Converts bold text (**text** or __text__) to <strong> tags
Converts italic text (*text* or _text_) to <em> tags
Converts unordered lists (lines starting with - or *) to <ul><li> tags
Converts ordered lists (lines starting with numbers) to <ol><li> tags
Converts fenced code blocks (```) to <pre><code> tags

Wraps plain paragraphs in

tags with blank line separation
Includes a basic inline CSS stylesheet in the HTML head for readable formatting
Displays an error message if the input file does not exist
